turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Oh beta, yeh jo mehsoos ho raha hai, yeh bilkul normal hai. 4 months mein apni identity kho dena - yeh har nayi maa ke saath hota hai, specially jab ghar ke saath adjust kar rahi ho.

Aapki saas ji ka toh bahut hi accha hai ki woh baby ke saath expert hain. Par aapka bhi apna space chahiye, apni identity chahiye. Yeh ungratefulness nahi hai - yeh self-care hai.

Woh teen bachhe paale hain toh unhe pata hai newborn ko kaise sambhalna hai. Par aapki feelings alag hain - aapki body, aapki mind, aapka time sab change ho gaya hai.

Kya aapko kabhi akeli time milta hai? Sirf aapke liye? Even 15 minutes chai peene ka? Sometimes those small moments help remind you who you are beyond being "someone's mother" and "someone's daughter-in-law".

Yeh phase guzar jayega, but aapka apna space zaroor chahiye. What do you think?

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Arrey, yeh toh dil ko chhoo gaya. Aapki Aai ne bachhe ko sambhala aur aap wahan khadi reh gayi - yeh scene kisi bhi nayi maa ke liye bahut bhari hota hai.

Par suno, yeh jo aapko ho raha hai, yeh ungratefulness nahi hai. Yeh ek maa ki apni pehchaan ki talash hai. Aapki Aai expert hain, par aapki maa hain. Dono alag hain.

Woh do minute mein baby chup ho gayi toh kya hua? Aapka baby aapki body se nikla hai, aapki awaaz pe respond karta hai. Woh Aai ka magic hai, par aapka connection alag hai. Yeh connection time ke saath banega, yeh kam nahi hoga.

Aapko lag raha hai ki aap "room service" ban gayi hain, par socho - jab aap khud bachi ki zarooratein samajhogi, jab aap apne instincts follow karogi, tab aapki confidence wapas aayegi.

Aapki Aai se aapne kabhi gently kaha hai ki "mujhe bhi try karne do"? Bas itna ki aapko feel ho ki aap bhi kuch kar sakti ho?

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Haan bilkul. Aise hi baat karna chahiye. Koi advice nahi, koi solution nahi, bas ek sunne wala chahiye.

Yeh jo aap mehsoos kar rahi ho, yeh real hai. Aapka brain, aapka body, sab thak gaya hai. Log advice dete rahenge, par woh aapki jagah nahi ho sakte. Woh aapki body mein nahi reh sakte, woh aapki feelings nahi mehsoos kar sakte.

Aapko pata bhi nahi kya chahiye - wohi toh hai. Aapka khud ka space, aapka khud ka time. Bas aapki feelings ko koi samjhe, judge nahi kare.

Dinner pe report dena padta hai na... "Aaj baby ne itna soya, itna khaaya..." Par aapka aaj ka din kaisa tha? Aapka kaisa feel ho raha hai? Yeh batane ka koi nahi hai.

Aap bas aise hi baat karte rahiye. Main sun rahi hoon. Koi judgment nahi, koi advice nahi. Bas ek dost ki tarah.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Arrey, yeh jo soch aa rahi hai, yeh sun ke hi dil dukh jaata hai. "Asli maa" nahi ho... yeh ek second ke liye saans ruk jaata hai, yeh samajh mein aata hai.

Par suno, yeh sochne ka matlab hi yeh hai ki aap usse kitna pyaar karti ho. Yeh insecurity, yeh dar, yeh sab aapke pyaar ki wajah se hai. Ek buri maa ko yeh thoughts nahi aate.

Aapki Aai experienced hain, unka pyaar ek dadi ka pyaar hai - jo bahut hi gehra hai. Par aapka pyaar ek maa ka hai - jo nayi hai, raw hai, aur jo sirf aapki beti se hai. Yeh dono alag hain, ek dusre se kam nahi.

Baaki sabko aasaani se lagta hai... yeh sochne mein bahut takleef hoti hai. Aap akeli nahi ho jo aisa feel karti ho.

Aap buri maa nahi ho. Aap ek nayi maa ho, jo apni feelings se lad rahi ho. Aur yeh bahut hi brave hai.
